blocks.text: Abbotsford East Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: The east side's working roads in City and transit material are Whatcom Road, McKee Road, Old Yale Road, Old Clayburn Road, McMillan Road and Sumas Way, with the mountainside rising on McKee Road and the low land running south toward the Sumas River.
Abbotsford East is not one City neighbourhood name, and the east side is planned through named areas including McKee, Clayburn, Sandy Hill, Auguston and McMillan.

blocks.text: Abbotsford East Houses: the housing stock

items.t: Detached houses dominate the east side, and the zoning floor for a new interior lot is 540 m² in the RS3 zone and 420 m² in the RS5 zone, as a City council report applying Zoning Bylaw No. 2400-2014 states.

The east side's newer detached product sits in the McKee plan area, and the City's McKee Neighbourhood Plan covers approximately 842 hectares on Sumas Mountain, described as a landscape of steep forested slopes and headwater tributaries.

Older established streets run along Old Yale Road and Old Clayburn Road, and the route 9 schedule reads the east side through McMillan Road at Old Yale Road, McKee Drive at McKee Road, and Old Clayburn Road at Sandy Hill Road.

blocks.text: Abbotsford East Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A secondary suite must sit inside the principal dwelling and be registered with the City, and registration confirms the suite complies with the BC Building Code and the Abbotsford Zoning Bylaw, 2014.

Suite eligibility has street-level conditions, and City policy criteria applied in council reports require a lot of at least 400 m², at least 12.0 m of frontage, a Collector or Local road, and no location on a cul-de-sac bulb.

Slope lots carry a hazard rule, and a City council report for an east-side lot records a geotechnical covenant on title requiring no buildings within 1.5 m of the crest of the slope at the rear of the property.

blocks.text: Abbotsford East Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Non-catchment requests are restricted at Robert Bateman Secondary and Yale Secondary and all their feeder schools, and SD34 states it has restricted those requests to reduce enrolment over time — an east-side address outside the Bateman or Yale catchment is not a reliable route into those schools.

Owners are billed annually for solid waste collection and secondary suites on the property tax notice, and the City states registered owners are billed for property taxes, solid waste collection, secondary suites and other charges in one annual billing.

blocks.text: Abbotsford East Houses: development and new projects

items.t: The McKee Neighbourhood Plan is the east side's active planning framework, and it was adopted June 26, 2023 as Official Community Plan Amendment Bylaw No. 3400-2023, with the plan added as Schedule "E" of the Official Community Plan.

blocks.text: Abbotsford East Houses: costs and taxes

items.t: Abbotsford's 2026 residential (Class 1) municipal rates are 1.08284 per $1,000 for police and 1.78296 per $1,000 for general and debt servicing under Tax Rates Bylaw No. 3727-2026, before regional and library levies.

Houses inside the Sumas Prairie Dyking and Drainage Area pay an additional residential rate, set for 2026 at 0.58353 per $1,000 for Class 1 residential properties, so a south-edge house can carry a dyking line that a hillside house does not.
Metered water costs $1.46 per cubic metre and sewer $1.35 per cubic metre for residential customers, effective March 1, 2026, after a Council-approved 4% increase to each rate in January 2026.
The Speculation and Vacancy Tax applies here, because the Province's taxable-areas list names the City of Abbotsford.

blocks.text: Abbotsford East Houses: getting around

items.t: Highway 1 runs along the south side of the east side, and route 9 links the mountainside to Montrose Exchange and, on some trips, Bourquin Exchange, via McMillan Road and Old Yale Road.

Whatcom Road is the east side's highway connection, and the route 9 schedule's east-side stops run from McMillan Road at Old Yale Road through McKee Drive at McKee Road to Old Clayburn Road at Sandy Hill Road.
The east side's regional trips run by bus through the exchanges, and route 9's schedule shows Bourquin Exchange as the end point of its through trips from Montrose Exchange.

blocks.text: Abbotsford East Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check slope lots for a geotechnical covenant, because a City report for an east-side lot records a covenant barring buildings within 1.5 m of the slope crest at the rear of the property.
Confirm a suite is registered, not merely finished, because the City requires registration and a registered suite is the one confirmed against the BC Building Code and the Zoning Bylaw.

blocks.text: Abbotsford East home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

261 houses sold in Abbotsford East with a median price of $1,060,000 (the middle half sold between $939,900 and $1,285,000), taking a median of 23 days to sell at 97.2% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $387 per square foot, a median year built of 1993 and a median lot of 7,205 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Abbotsford East?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 153 houses listed in Abbotsford East. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Abbotsford East a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Abbotsford East had a sales ratio of 23%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Abbotsford East from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 142 houses sold in Abbotsford East over those 5 months, out of 287 in all of Abbotsford.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Abbotsford East?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Abbotsford East sell for?
faq.a: 261 houses sold in Abbotsford East between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,060,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Abbotsford East?
faq.a: The median was 23 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.2% of the last list price (8% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
